claim_boundary: Independent hostile audit of Route-A v2. PROVED labels are restricted to the frozen-source text comparisons and exact exponent arithmetic. This record does not alter v2, does not close the archival published-primary formula gate, and does not promote Stream C or G0.

route_a_v2_replay_design.finding: The v2 writer embeds wall_time_ns, so its byte artifact changes on replay. This is a reproducibility-design defect, not an unexplained content mutation. This audit pins only the stable semantic identity.
route_a_v2_replay_design.safe_remediation: A future version should put performance timing in a separate artifact or compare a canonical form excluding timing; v2 is preserved.

chj_i_scope.source: M. Cully-Hugill and D. R. Johnston, On the error term in the explicit formula of Riemann--von Mangoldt, IJNT 19 (2023), Theorem 1.2; frozen arXiv 2111.10001v5 source.
chj_i_scope.statement_checked: For any alpha in (0,1/2], max{51,log z}<T<(z^alpha-2)/2, psi(z)=z-sum_(|gamma|<=T)z^rho/rho+O*(M z log z/T).
chj_i_scope.structural_limit_checked: The source explicitly records that alpha>1/2 cannot be taken.

uniform.endpoint_result: Eventually admissible at both x and x+y under CHJ-I.

almost_all.conclusion: T_a is eventually outside CHJ-I's alpha<=1/2 range at endpoints z in [X,3X].

route_a_v2_promotion.conclusion: The assertion that CHJ-I Theorem 1.2 alone closes the prescribed-height explicit formula is unsupported for the almost-all branch. A full Route-A-v2 PASS is not licensed by CHJ-I alone.

endpoint.finding: CHJ-I's psi(z)=sum_(n<=z)Lambda(n) subtracts to a half-open interval; conversion to GM's [x,x+y] costs O(log x) at an integral endpoint.

height_notation.finding: CHJ-I truncates by |gamma|<=T; GM TeX prints |rho|<=T. Literal complex-modulus reading needs a separate thin-boundary bridge.

multiplicity.finding: CHJ-I says all non-trivial zeros but its frozen source contains no explicit multiplicity statement. Ford's convention cannot by itself assign a convention to CHJ-I.

safe_common_source_node.status: PROVED conditional on the stated Iwaniec theorem; source-access status OBSERVED
safe_common_source_node.mechanism: Iwaniec arbitrary-height theorem plus endpoint half-weights, HSW's unit count, Bui--Heath-Brown's multiplicity convention, and the thin-boundary transfer.

frozen_cc_corroboration.checked_content: The theorem is for all x>=2,T>0; the proof says every zero residue is counted with multiplicity.
frozen_cc_corroboration.license_provenance: Course identifier is MIT OCW handle 1721.1/101679; the official DSpace download endpoint returned HTTP 405 in this run, and the author-hosted course copies were frozen.

archival_published_primary_gate.finding: No lawfully archivable published-primary source with the full fixed-height theorem was frozen in this audit. The CC course source corroborates but does not replace that primary-source requirement.

route_b_v4.reason: Without a replayable published-primary formula node, a closure would violate the archival gate. Route-B v3 remains the controlling containment record.
